Monday-start 2027; year dates open day pages, month pages link to habit tracker, week chips and every in-month date, week boxes open days, day pages have prev/next (Jan 1 back to Dec 31, 2026); head start from Mon Oct 26, 2026 verified in the PDF links.

coverage.where: year, m01, m01h, w03, d0111, projects, notes, grid
coverage.note: Year at a glance, 12 months with This month's focus, 12 monthly habit trackers, 53 weeks, 365 time-blocked days, projects, 10 lined notes and 6 dot grid pages all present.
Clean Outfit/Manrope type, consistent boxes and spacing, grays only, no ornament; exceptions are the gray-tinted cover and two solid black month tiles on Contents (see visual).
Start here page inside the file gives reMarkable steps (browser download, desktop app / my.remarkable.com / USB web interface, tap with finger, write with pen).

coverage.where: PDF pages; listing description Works with / Not for; linktest
coverage.note: 3:4 pages, PDF colors are only grays (0, .07, .30, .62, .92, 1), thin vector strokes; Works with / Not for (Paper Pro Move, phones, iPad apps) is in the description; Setup check page exists. Left margin is the normal 48 pt, not visibly wider than elsewhere.
One PDF, 10.8 MB (10,824,126 bytes), not a zip; browser download, desktop app / my.remarkable.com / USB route and 'No Connect subscription is needed' are in the listing, photo 4 steps and Start here.

Description covers it all, but the photos break the promise: most show whole pages shrunk into a tablet frame (photo 5's year page is unreadable), alt text for photos 2, 4 and 5 describes callouts, circles and a Works with panel that are not in the image, and photo 10 does not mention which tablets it fits or no handwriting-to-text.
Parsed every link annotation: 0 broken, all 542 pages reachable from the cover; Setup check buttons go to January, Year and Contents, and the page says how to come back (Home, then Setup check).

Month tabs on the right, Home/Year/Projects/Notes top bar, Month / Week trail on calendar pages, every in-month date on month pages opens its day, prev/next arrows on days, Contents links every section and month.
Cover Open planner links to page 3 Start here (4 steps written for reMarkable); Setup check is page 4; both are the first two cards on Contents.

coverage.where: year, m01, w03, d0111, photo-02, photo-06
coverage.note: One dated planner with linked year/month/week/day; photo 2 shows a day page and photo 6 a week page (whole page in a frame, not literally real size).
Listed counts add up to 542 and match the file (12+12+53+365 + 2 months, 9 weeks, 67 days head start + 6 front/work pages + 10 notes + 6 dot grid); every day page has Notes and Done today.
Price 69; complete dated 2027 plus head start in one file; day pages have 6am-10pm blocks, 8-line to-do, notes. The 25% launch sale is a shop setting and is not visible in listing.json.
Strict date order (head start, then each month, its habit tracker, weeks and days), each week and day once, 0 broken links, all text is embedded vector fonts; no photos used.

visual.issue: Alt text and photo copy describe things not in the frames: photo 2 'top half ... with callouts' shows the whole page with no callouts; photo 5 says tabs, Home and trail are 'circled' but nothing is circled; photo 4 alt and points promise a Works with / not for Paper Pro Move panel that the image does not show (it shows the download steps instead).
Whole pages shrunk into a 2x2 grid; the year-at-a-glance and month thumbnails are too small to read at Etsy zoom (rule r013).
Photos 2 and 6 are captioned 'real size' but show the full page reduced inside a tablet frame; photos 3, 7, 8, 9 also show whole pages small instead of a readable crop.
visual.where: photo-02, photo-06, photo-03, photo-07, photo-08, photo-09

visual.issue: Every mockup uses a black-bezel generic tablet that reads as an iPad, on a listing that says it is not for iPad apps; no frame looks like a reMarkable.
Two large solid black tiles (November and December 2026) on Contents, against the brief's own rule that large dark areas ghost on e-ink.
Cover background is light gray (#EBEBEB) instead of pure white; the brief says any tint dithers into gray dots on e-ink, and photo 1 shows it.

Before Monday Oct 26, 2026 there is no page for today: a buyer on Oct 22-25 follows 'tap Head start, then today's date' and finds the planner starts next Monday, while the listing says 'begin this week'.
Week page has two boxes both titled NOTES (dot grid and lined), and the Top 3 box is half empty.
Week chips wrap onto a second line (Week 5 alone under the others).
Year page title wraps to '2027 at a / glance' and 'TAP ANY DATE' and the Head start button text break across two lines.
Start here 'top bar' box lists Year, Projects and Notes but leaves out Home, leaving an empty cell; Setup check repeats 'SETUP CHECK' as eyebrow and title.
NOV and DEC tabs mean November/December 2026 on head start pages but 2027 everywhere else, without a label.
Week 1 and head start week 1 have only a forward arrow; Week 1 of 2027 has no arrow back to the last head start week.
Projects table has column headings but no column dividers, so Next step / Due / Done have no guides.
Large empty gap between the two tablets, with the third bullet dropping onto its own line.
Listing ends 'we'll help you set it up', which edges toward a service promise (rule r007).
